biomedical_concept.name: Inclusion Criteria
biomedical_concept.label: Inclusion Criteria
biomedical_concept.description: Medical and/or social characteristics which are necessary for a subject to be allowed to participate in a clinical study, as outlined in the study protocol. Meeting inclusion criteria is not a sufficient condition for entry or recruitment of a subject into the study. Characteristics limiting the eligibility of a subject for the clinical study must be considered.

biomedical_concept.name: Inclusion Exclusion Criteria Yes No Indicator
biomedical_concept.label: Inclusion Exclusion Criteria Yes No Indicator
biomedical_concept.description: An indication of whether inclusion or exclusion criteria has been met.

biomedical_concept.name: Exclusion Criteria
biomedical_concept.label: Exclusion Criteria

biomedical_concept.name: Subject is Randomized
biomedical_concept.label: Subject is Randomized
biomedical_concept.description: A status indication that a subject is already assigned to an arm of a clinical trial by chance.

biomedical_concept.name: Race
biomedical_concept.label: Race
biomedical_concept.description: A geographic ancestral origin category that is assigned to a population group based mainly on physical characteristics that are thought to be distinct and inherent.

biomedical_concept.name: Ethnic Group
biomedical_concept.label: Ethnic Group
biomedical_concept.description: A social group characterized by a distinctive social and cultural tradition that is maintained from generation to generation. Members share a common history and origin and a sense of identification with the group. They have similar and distinctive features in their lifestyle habits and shared experiences. They often have a common genetic heritage which may be reflected in their experience of health and disease.

biomedical_concept.name: Subject Age
biomedical_concept.label: Subject Age
biomedical_concept.description: The age of a person who is the subject in a study.

biomedical_concept.name: Birth Date and Time
biomedical_concept.label: Birth Date and Time
biomedical_concept.description: The date and time of a birth event.

biomedical_concept.name: Education Level
biomedical_concept.label: Education Level
biomedical_concept.description: An indication of the years of schooling completed in graded public, private, or parochial schools, and in colleges, universities, or professional schools.

biomedical_concept.name: Number of Years of Education
biomedical_concept.label: Number of Years of Education
biomedical_concept.description: The number of education years that a subject has competed.

biomedical_concept.name: Solicited Medical History
biomedical_concept.label: Solicited Medical History
biomedical_concept.description: Information about an individual's personal medical history that is reported by a healthcare professional, consumer, or patient through an organized data collection system.

biomedical_concept.name: Alcohol Use History
biomedical_concept.label: Alcohol Use History
biomedical_concept.description: A description of an individual's current and past experience with alcoholic beverage consumption.

biomedical_concept.name: Caffeine Use History
biomedical_concept.label: Caffeine Use History
biomedical_concept.description: A description of an individual's current or previous caffeine consumption.

biomedical_concept.name: History of Tobacco Use
biomedical_concept.label: History of Tobacco Use
biomedical_concept.description: A description of an individual's current or previous use of tobacco.

biomedical_concept.name: X-Ray Imaging
biomedical_concept.label: X-Ray Imaging
biomedical_concept.description: A radiographic procedure using the emission of x-rays to form an image of the structure penetrated by the radiation.

biomedical_concept.name: Body Temperature
biomedical_concept.label: Body Temperature
biomedical_concept.description: A measurement of the temperature of the body.

biomedical_concept.name: Body Weight
biomedical_concept.label: Body Weight
biomedical_concept.description: The weight of a subject.

biomedical_concept.name: Body Height
biomedical_concept.label: Body Height
biomedical_concept.description: The vertical measurement or distance from the base to the top of a subject or participant.

biomedical_concept.name: Pulse Rate
biomedical_concept.label: Pulse Rate
biomedical_concept.description: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomic sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.

biomedical_concept.name: Respiratory Rate
biomedical_concept.label: Respiratory Rate
biomedical_concept.description: The rate of breathing (inhalation and exhalation) measured within in a unit time, usually expressed as breaths per minute.

biomedical_concept.name: Body Mass Index
biomedical_concept.label: Body Mass Index
biomedical_concept.description: An individual's weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters.

biomedical_concept.name: Blood Pressure
biomedical_concept.label: Blood Pressure
biomedical_concept.description: The pressure of the circulating blood against the walls of the blood vessels.

biomedical_concept.name: Electrocardiogram Analysis
biomedical_concept.label: Electrocardiogram Analysis
biomedical_concept.description: The examination and interpretation of electrocardiogram data.

biomedical_concept.name: Atrioventricular Conduction ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Atrioventricular Conduction ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the transmission of electrical impulses between the atria and ventricles.

biomedical_concept.name: Axis and Voltage ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Axis and Voltage ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the mean cardiac electrical vector and ECG voltage.

biomedical_concept.name: Chamber Hypertrophy or Enlargement ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Chamber Hypertrophy or Enlargement ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of chamber hypertrophy or enlargement.

biomedical_concept.name: ECG Technical Quality
biomedical_concept.label: ECG Technical Quality
biomedical_concept.description: A statement about an electrocardiographic recording describing technical issues or interference during the recording, processing, or transmission of the data. This does not represent an electrocardiographic diagnosis. (CDISC)

biomedical_concept.name: Intraventricular and Intraatrial Conduction ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Intraventricular and Intraatrial Conduction ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the transmission of electrical impulses through the cardiac atria and ventricles.

biomedical_concept.name: Myocardial Infarction ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Myocardial Infarction ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of findings that suggest the occurrence of a myocardial infarction.

biomedical_concept.name: Pacemaker ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Pacemaker ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the rate of firing of a an artificial, mechanical pacemaker.

biomedical_concept.name: Rhythm Not Otherwise Specified ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Rhythm Not Otherwise Specified ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of a cardiac rhythm that is not specified in a particular list.

biomedical_concept.name: ST Segment, T wave, and U wave ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: ST Segment, T wave, and U wave ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the characteristics of the ST segment, T wave, and U wave.

biomedical_concept.name: Sinus Node Rhythm and Arrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Sinus Node Rhythm and Arrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the typical and atypical cardiac rhythms originating from the sinoatrial node.

biomedical_concept.name: Supraventricular Arrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Supraventricular Arrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the atypical cardiac rhythms originating in the atrium, AV node or AV junction.

biomedical_concept.name: Supraventricular Tachyarrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Supraventricular Tachyarrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the abnormally fast cardiac rhythms originating above the ventricles.

biomedical_concept.name: Aggregate PR Interval
biomedical_concept.label: Aggregate PR Interval
biomedical_concept.description: An aggregate PR value based on the measurement of PR intervals from multiple beats within a single ECG. The method of aggregation, which can vary, is typically a measure of central tendency such as the mean. (CDISC)

biomedical_concept.name: Aggregate QRS Duration
biomedical_concept.label: Aggregate QRS Duration
biomedical_concept.description: An aggregate QRS value based on the measurement of QRS intervals from multiple beats within a single ECG. The method of aggregation, which can vary, is typically a measure of central tendency such as the mean. (CDISC)

biomedical_concept.name: Aggregate QT Interval
biomedical_concept.label: Aggregate QT Interval
biomedical_concept.description: An aggregate QT value based on the measurement of QT intervals from multiple beats within a single ECG. The method of aggregation, which can vary, is typically a measure of central tendency such as the mean. (CDISC)

biomedical_concept.name: Aggregate QTCB Interval
biomedical_concept.label: Aggregate QTCB Interval
biomedical_concept.description: A QT aggregate interval corrected for heart rate using Bazett's formula.

biomedical_concept.name: Aggregate QTCF Interval
biomedical_concept.label: Aggregate QTCF Interval
biomedical_concept.description: A QT aggregate interval corrected for heart rate using Fridericia's formula.

biomedical_concept.name: Aggregate RR Interval
biomedical_concept.label: Aggregate RR Interval
biomedical_concept.description: An aggregate RR value based on the measurement of RR intervals from multiple beats within a single ECG. The method of aggregation, which can vary, is typically a measure of central tendency such as the mean. (CDISC)

biomedical_concept.name: Mean Heart Rate by Electrocardiogram
biomedical_concept.label: Mean Heart Rate by Electrocardiogram
biomedical_concept.description: The calculated average rate of depolarisation of a specific region of the heart, most often the ventricles, as measured and recorded by an electrocardiograph during a specified, extended period of time, and which is usually expressed in beats per minute.

biomedical_concept.name: QRS Axis
biomedical_concept.label: QRS Axis
biomedical_concept.description: A numerical representation of the electrocardiographic vector assessed at maximum deviation of the QRS complex from the isoelectric baseline, usually reported for the frontal plane. (CDISC)

biomedical_concept.name: QTc Correction Method Unspecified, Aggregate
biomedical_concept.label: QTc Correction Method Unspecified, Aggregate
biomedical_concept.description: A QT aggregate interval that is corrected for heart rate by unspecified correction method, or by non-standard correction methods.

biomedical_concept.name: Ventricular Arrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Ventricular Arrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the atypical cardiac rhythms originating in the ventricle.

biomedical_concept.name: Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia ECG Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: An electrocardiographic assessment of the abnormally fast cardiac rhythms originating within the ventricles.

biomedical_concept.name: Computed Tomography
biomedical_concept.label: Computed Tomography
biomedical_concept.description: A method of examining structures within the body by scanning them with X rays and using a computer to construct a series of cross-sectional scans along a single axis.

biomedical_concept.name: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
biomedical_concept.label: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
biomedical_concept.description: Imaging that uses radiofrequency waves and a strong magnetic field rather than x-rays to provide detailed pictures of internal organs and tissues. The technique is valuable for the diagnosis of many pathologic conditions, including cancer, heart and vascular disease, stroke, and joint and musculoskeletal disorders.

biomedical_concept.name: Concomitant Medication Yes No Indicator
biomedical_concept.label: Concomitant Medication Yes No Indicator
biomedical_concept.description: An indication of whether concomitant medication usage has occurred.

biomedical_concept.name: Concomitant Therapy
biomedical_concept.label: Concomitant Therapy
biomedical_concept.description: Any pharmaceutical agent, other than the primary therapy, that is administered to or used by the subject prior to or during a specified time period.

biomedical_concept.name: Hemoglobin Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Hemoglobin Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of hemoglobin present in a biospecimen.

biomedical_concept.name: Hematocrit Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Hematocrit Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A measure of the volume of red blood cells expressed as a percentage of the total blood volume. Normal in males is 43-49%, in females 37-43%.

biomedical_concept.name: Erythrocyte Count
biomedical_concept.label: Erythrocyte Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of erythrocytes in a biospecimen.

biomedical_concept.name: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin
biomedical_concept.label: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin
biomedical_concept.description: The mean cell hemoglobin (MCH), which is the average amount of hemoglobin in the average red cell. The MCH is a calculated value derived from the measurement of hemoglobin and the red cell count.

biomedical_concept.name: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Volume
biomedical_concept.label: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Volume
biomedical_concept.description: The mean cell volume is the average volume of a red blood cell. This is a calculated value derived from the hematocrit and the red cell count.

biomedical_concept.name: Leukocyte Count
biomedical_concept.label: Leukocyte Count
biomedical_concept.description: A test to determine the number of leukocytes in a biospecimen.

biomedical_concept.name: Segmented Neutrophil Count
biomedical_concept.label: Segmented Neutrophil Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of segmented neutrophils present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Neutrophil Band Form Count
biomedical_concept.label: Neutrophil Band Form Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of band neutrophils in a blood sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Absolute Neutrophil Count
biomedical_concept.label: Absolute Neutrophil Count
biomedical_concept.description: The real number of white blood cells (WBC) that are neutrophils. It is derived by multiplying the WBC count by the percent of neutrophils in the differential WBC count. The normal range for ANC is 1.5 to 8.0 (1,500 to 8,000/mm3).

biomedical_concept.name: Monocyte Count
biomedical_concept.label: Monocyte Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of monocytes in a blood sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Eosinophil Count
biomedical_concept.label: Eosinophil Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of eosinophils in a blood sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Absolute Basophil Count
biomedical_concept.label: Absolute Basophil Count
biomedical_concept.description: The total number of white blood cells that are basophils. It is calculated by multiplying the white blood cell count by the percent of basophils in the differential white blood cell count.

biomedical_concept.name: Platelet Count
biomedical_concept.label: Platelet Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of platelets in a biospecimen.

biomedical_concept.name: Microcyte Count
biomedical_concept.label: Microcyte Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of microcytes in a blood sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Macrocyte Count
biomedical_concept.label: Macrocyte Count
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of macrocytes in a blood sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Anisocyte Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Anisocyte Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of anisocytes present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Poikilocyte Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Poikilocyte Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the number of poikilocytes present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Polychromasia
biomedical_concept.label: Polychromasia
biomedical_concept.description: The reaction of red cells to stain as indicated by the appearance of bluish or grayish colored erythrocytes.

biomedical_concept.name: Alanine Aminotransferase Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Alanine Aminotransferase Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of alanine aminotransferase present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Albumin Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Albumin Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of albumin present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Alkaline Phosphatase Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Alkaline Phosphatase Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of alkaline phosphatase present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Aspartate Aminotransferase Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Aspartate Aminotransferase Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of aspartate aminotransferase present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Creatinine Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Creatinine Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of creatinine present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Potassium Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Potassium Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of potassium present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Sodium Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Sodium Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of sodium present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Urea Nitrogen Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Urea Nitrogen Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of urea nitrogen present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Bicarbonate Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Bicarbonate Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of bicarbonate present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Chloride Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Chloride Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of chloride present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Total Bilirubin Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Total Bilirubin Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The measurement of the total amount of bilirubin present in a particular substrate. The substrate most often tested is blood, but other fluids extracted from the body may be used periodically depending on the purpose of the test.

biomedical_concept.name: Gamma Glutamyl Transpeptidase Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Gamma Glutamyl Transpeptidase Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of gamma glutamyl transpeptidase present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Urate Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Urate Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of urate present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Phosphate Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Phosphate Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of phosphate present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Calcium Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Calcium Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of calcium present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Glucose Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Glucose Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of glucose present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Total Protein Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Total Protein Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of total protein present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Cholesterol Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Cholesterol Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of total cholesterol present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Triiodothyronine Uptake Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Triiodothyronine Uptake Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the binding of triiodothyonine to thyroxine binding globulin protein in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Triiodothyronine Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Triiodothyronine Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of free and bound triiodothyronine present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Free Thyroxine Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Free Thyroxine Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of free thyroxine present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Free Thyroxine Index
biomedical_concept.label: Free Thyroxine Index
biomedical_concept.description: A measurement of the thyroid status (function, disease diagnosis, or therapy effectiveness) in a biological specimen. This is calculated by a mathematical formula that takes into account the total thyroxine and unbound thyroxine binding globulins.

biomedical_concept.name: Thyrotropin Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Thyrotropin Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of thyrotropin present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Folic Acid Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Folic Acid Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of folic acid present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Vitamin B12 Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Vitamin B12 Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of vitamin B12 present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Treponema pallidum Antibody Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Treponema pallidum Antibody Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of Treponema pallidum antibody in a biological sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Treponema pallidum DNA Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Treponema pallidum DNA Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of Treponema pallidum DNA present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Color Assessment
biomedical_concept.label: Color Assessment
biomedical_concept.description: A qualitative assessment of the color of a biological specimen.

biomedical_concept.name: Specific Gravity
biomedical_concept.label: Specific Gravity
biomedical_concept.description: The density (mass per unit volume) of any material divided by that of water at a standard temperature.

biomedical_concept.name: Ketone Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Ketone Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of ketones present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Urobilinogen Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Urobilinogen Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of urobilinogen present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Occult Blood Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Occult Blood Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A measurement of the blood in body products such as a urine or stool sample, not detectable on gross examination.

biomedical_concept.name: Nitrite Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Nitrite Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: A quantitative measurement of the amount of nitrite present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Hemoglobin A1C Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Hemoglobin A1C Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the amount of hemoglobin A1C present in a sample.

biomedical_concept.name: Hemoglobin A1C to Hemoglobin Ratio Measurement
biomedical_concept.label: Hemoglobin A1C to Hemoglobin Ratio Measurement
biomedical_concept.description: The determination of the ratio of the glycosylated hemoglobin compared to total hemoglobin present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.

biomedical_concept.name: Exposure as Collected Domain
biomedical_concept.label: Exposure as Collected Domain
biomedical_concept.description: This interventions domain model reflects protocol-specified study treatment administrations, as collected.

biomedical_concept.name: TTS Acceptability Survey
biomedical_concept.label: TTS Acceptability Survey
biomedical_concept.description: A survey question to assess acceptability of the transdermal patch

biomedical_concept.name: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Acceptability

biomedical_concept.description: A survey question to assess acceptability of using a transdermal patch compared to oral medication

biomedical_concept.name: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Appearance
biomedical_concept.label: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Appearance
biomedical_concept.description: A survey question to assess acceptability of the appearance of a transdermal patch

biomedical_concept.name: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Durability
biomedical_concept.label: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Durability
biomedical_concept.description: A survey question to assess acceptability of the durability of a transdermal patch

biomedical_concept.name: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Size
biomedical_concept.label: TTS Acceptability Survey -  Patch Size
biomedical_concept.description: A survey question to assess acceptability of the size of a transdermal patch

biomedical_concept.name: Adverse Event Yes No Indicator
biomedical_concept.label: Adverse Event Yes No Indicator
biomedical_concept.description: An indication of whether an adverse event has occurred.

biomedical_concept.name: Solicited Adverse Event
biomedical_concept.label: Solicited Adverse Event
biomedical_concept.description: An adverse event that is reported by a healthcare professional, consumer, or patient through an organized data collection system.

objective.name: OBJ1
objective.label: Objective 1
objective.text: To determine if there is a statistically significant relationship (overall Type 1 erroralpha=0.05) between the change in both the ADAS-Cog (11) and CIBIC+ scores, and drug dose (0, 50 cm2 [54 mg], and 75 cm2 [81 mg]).

objective.name: OBJ2
objective.label: Objective 2
objective.text: To document the safety profile of the xanomeline TTS.

objective.name: OBJ3
objective.label: Objective 3
objective.text: To assess the dose-dependent improvement in behavior. Improved scores on the Revised Neuropsychiatric Inventory (NPI-X) will indicate improvement in these areas.

objective.name: OBJ4
objective.label: Objective 4
objective.text: To assess the dose-dependent improvements in activities of daily living. Improved scores on the Disability Assessment for Dementia (DAD) will indicate improvement in these areas (see Attachment LZZT.5).

objective.name: OBJ5
objective.label: Objective 5
objective.text: To assess the dose-dependent improvements in an extended assessment of cognition that integrates attention/concentration tasks. The Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale-14 item Cognitive Subscale, hereafter referred to as ADAS-Cog (14), will be used for this assessment (see Attachment LZZT.2).

objective.name: OBJ6
objective.label: Objective 6
objective.text: To assess the treatment response as a function of Apo E genotype.
